summary: Improve volunteer role design, onboarding and retention with practical tools. Explore the five-day training outline and assess fit for your team.
lede: Volunteer management and engagement covers designing volunteer roles and supporting people through recruitment, preparation, supervision and recognition. For volunteer coordinators, supervisors and programme managers, the training builds practical ways to match volunteer motives to tasks, clarify responsibilities with RACI, and plan screening, onboarding and recognition. You will also practise reviewing participation and retention measures and using a PDCA cycle to identify programme improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who coordinate volunteers, supervise their work or shape the systems that support their contribution in nonprofit and community programmes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with volunteer coordination, volunteer supervision or nonprofit programme delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
